executive_summary.headline: Three user-supplied Amazon links resolve to three verified air-fryer product pages. Prices, ratings, commission rates and trend data are not published, because they could not be verified or the Associates policy does not allow them on this site.
bullets: Re-verification (2026-11-14): each short link was resolved again; titles, breadcrumbs and also-viewed ASINs match the records. The Agreement's disclosure wording, the Participation Requirements text, the Conditions of Use licence and the FTC and Associates guidance were re-read. Corrections: policy section numbers (F-17), the 'Sponsored' label observations (F-10), and competitor labels marked as paraphrased (F-20). Brand bylines and specification tables were not re-read (F-18). The automation conflict with Program Policies is flagged (F-19).

Identity verified: each link resolves to an Amazon product page (ASINs B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R, B08DKYBTPH). All three sit under the same Amazon category path (Home & Kitchen > Kitchen & Dining > Small Appliances > Fryers > Air Fryers). Flag F-04 covers the short-link codes.

Pricing and ratings withheld: the Associates Participation Requirements (Section 2(b) and Section 6(t)) allow prices and star ratings on a site only through Amazon-served links or Creators API / PA API. The pages were read, but no price, rating or review count is published (F-02).
Commission potential not calculable: the category commission schedule is behind an Amazon sign-in, so no rate is entered (F-01). Third-party sources conflict on the Kitchen rate.
Attribution unverified: the resolved links contain no Associates tag parameter (F-03). Confirm the links are generated under your Associates ID before relying on any earnings.

Compliance: the required disclosure sentence appears on every page (R-01). Open legal items: the Conditions of Use limit collecting listing content, data mining and using Amazon content for AI models (F-11, F-12). The AI content automation is therefore NOT built.

Not built: automated product research, PA-API integration, click and conversion tracking, AI article generation and campaign optimisation. Each needs PA-API or Associates reporting access, a rate source, or a compliance decision first.
Site: static GitHub Pages site (source: main, path /; the root index.html redirects to docs/). Every table row links to an official source, and unverified values are blank and flagged.

Program economics are sourced rather than blank: the official Table 1 rate for the Kitchen band (4.50%) is recorded against all three products with its source, the automation layer is implemented in engine/ behind compliance gates that block any unverified claim, and the Amazon text notice required by IP License Section 2(k) is displayed on every page.
decisions_needed: Confirm whether the links were generated under your Associates ID (F-03), and which Amazon marketplace they should target (F-09).
Read the category commission rate from Associates Central and send it for entry (F-01).
Choose whether to apply for PA-API / Creators API access so prices and ratings can be shown (F-02, F-16).
Decide whether automated research and AI article generation may use Amazon-derived data, after review (F-11, F-12).

analysis.finding: All three products are in one niche: countertop air fryers and air-fry toaster ovens.
analysis.basis: Breadcrumb on all three product pages: Home & Kitchen > Kitchen & Dining > Small Appliances > Fryers > Air Fryers.

analysis.finding: Two of the three products share a brand (Chefman). The third is Emeril (Item details table; byline to confirm, F-05).
analysis.basis: Brand byline on P1 and P3 reads Chefman. P2 shows store 'Emeril Store' and byline 'Innovation IQ' (F-05).
analysis.confidence: P2 brand from the Item details table, re-read 2026-11-14 (byline to confirm, F-05); P1 and P3 from the earlier session (byline not re-read, F-18)

analysis.finding: The set spans three formats: a 6-litre dual-basket oven (P1), an 8-quart single-basket air fryer (P3) and a 24.6-litre French-door toaster oven (P2).
analysis.basis: Capacity fields as listed. The units differ across title and specification (F-06), so values are shown as listed, not compared numerically.

analysis.finding: Amazon's own 'also viewed' lists show competing air fryers from at least six other brands. P1 and P3 each list another Chefman model.
analysis.basis: Also-viewed carousel (stored ASIN lists, first three items per product). On the 2026-11-14 read the P3 carousel is labelled 'Sponsored'; the P1 label was not seen on that read; P2 is not labelled (F-10). Carousel membership changes between page loads, so the lists are snapshots (F-23).
analysis.confidence: Verified as shown (re-read 2026-11-14); sponsored labels vary (F-10)

analysis.finding: Commission percentage is known; commission per sale still cannot be stated on this site.
analysis.basis: Qualifying Revenue is the price less shipping, tax and similar items (Commission Income Statement, Section 1) and the Kitchen band is 4.50% per the official Table 1 read on 2026-11-14 (see A-08). A per-sale figure still cannot be published because no price may be displayed without approved content sourcing (F-02) and no traffic is measured (F-03, F-25). The rate itself is no longer unverified; the earlier note that the schedule sat behind a sign-in was incorrect.
analysis.confidence: Rate verified; per-sale figure not computable

analysis.finding: Trend and conversion performance cannot be measured from verified sources.
analysis.basis: No official trend or conversion data was available. Amazon's on-page popularity badges are not reproduced (F-15).

analysis.finding: Attribution to the user's Associates account is not confirmed.
analysis.basis: The resolved product URLs carry no 'tag=' parameter (F-03).

analysis.finding: Pricing analysis is blocked by a rule that is more specific than the price-display rule: the Site must not have price tracking or price alerting functionality.
analysis.basis: Participation Requirements Section 6(y): 'Unless otherwise agreed by Amazon, your Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality.' This sits alongside Section 2(b), which limits price display to Amazon-served links or Creators API / PA API data.

analysis.finding: What the site can prove, it proves; what it cannot, it leaves blank. That split is enforced, not asserted.
analysis.basis: scripts/verify.py parses every table body row on every page and fails the build if a row has no link to an official host, if any page lacks the Operating Agreement Section 5 disclosure sentence, or if any page contains a currency amount or a star rating. The Site checks workflow runs it on every push and pull request.

analysis.finding: Automated product research is gated by account activity, not by code: the Creators API requires an enrolled Associates account plus at least 10 qualifying sales in the past 30 days.
analysis.basis: Creators API documentation, Prerequisites, read 2026-11-14. The automation layer implements the client boundary and refuses to substitute scraped or invented data while credentials are absent.

analysis.finding: Rates that matter for niche selection: top band is 10.00% (Luxury Beauty, Luxury Stores Beauty, Amazon Explore); the catch-all 'All Other Categories' is 4.00%; gift cards, alcoholic beverages and wireless service plans are 0.00%.
analysis.basis: Same official Table 1. A 20% 'Amazon Games' rate is widely repeated online, but no such row exists in the table retrieved on 2026-11-14, so no 20% figure is published anywhere here. A niche with no dedicated row still earns the 4.00% catch-all.

analysis.finding: Program Content may not be used to train machine-learning models without Amazon's written approval, and Amazon reviews or star ratings may be displayed only when obtained through the API.
analysis.basis: Participation Requirements clauses on content and on reviews/ratings, read 2026-11-14 and encoded as blocking controls in the compliance engine, so a draft that would violate either cannot publish.

analysis.finding: Content automation exists but has published nothing: every draft is blocked until each field in it is verified.
analysis.basis: The generator marks any field without an official source as a placeholder and the publish gate refuses drafts that still contain one (7 items currently blocked). Editorial quality checks follow Google's people-first self-assessment.

analysis.finding: Disclosure is the highest-value control here, and a 'DISCLOSURE' button or a comments-section note is explicitly inadequate.
analysis.basis: Operating Agreement Section 5 wording; Amazon's link-level disclosure help; the FTC's Endorsement Guides FAQ on proximity, clarity and what does not count, including that a superlative claim needs typicality data.

dual-basket-air-fryers.title: Dual-basket air fryers

single-basket-air-fryers.title: Single-basket air fryers

air-fryer-toaster-ovens.title: Air-fry toaster ovens
air-fryer-toaster-ovens.intro: Larger multi-function ovens that also air fry, toast and roast. Covers P2 (Emeril Lagasse 26QT French Door Multi-Function Air Fryer Toaster Oven). Brand Emeril from the Item details table; byline to confirm (F-05).

not_built: Live Amazon product data (blocked by the 10-qualifying-sales Creators API prerequisite, F-16, F-19, F-52).
Price, rating and review analysis on the public site (withheld, F-02; specification fields pending review, F-50).
Commission earnings per product (the rate is now sourced at 4.50%, but no price is published and no traffic is measured; F-01 narrowed).
Click, conversion and revenue tracking (ledger and attribution windows implemented in engine/tracking.py; no authorized reporting is connected, F-03, F-25).
AI-generated articles, comparisons and buying guides (generator built behind a publish gate; nothing publishes until fields are verified and legal review completes, F-12).
Campaign optimisation (scoring model implemented; it refuses to rank without verified inputs, so no ranking is published).
